name: hello-no-such-session

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_reattach.py — a hello for a session the worker does not hold is answered error no_such_session
core/internal/session/reattach_test.go — on no_such_session the core re-reads the spool, then ends the session E10 terminated / worker_lost only when no spooled end is there

description: Session model §9 E10's third case, which v0.1 cannot say: the worker answers that it holds no such session. The core then re-reads the spool for that session — the end may have landed between its first read and the dial — and writes a spooled end if there is one; only without one is it E10, terminated / worker_lost.
